column3: Dharmayathana  Conservation  Society
(Incorporation) Act, No. 53 of 2006
to maintain and develop the Dharmayathana and to
protect and preserve the image of the Aukana Buddha
Statue at Bauddhaloka Mawatha, Colombo ;
to preserve and foster the Buddhist philosophy and
the Buddhist way of life ;
to maintain the “Lakviru Sevana” house situated at
No. 48, Bodhirukkarama Road, Wellawatte ;
to provide assistance to the poor, destitute, disabled
and malnourished Buddhist children ;
to construct rests for the Buddhist clergy and laymen
in the capital city ;
to  establish  and  maintain  book  shops  and  library
services ;
to  hold  dhamma  preachings  and  discussions  in
Sinhala,  Tamil  and  English  languages  and  to
broadcast the same through the electronic media ;
to  publish  books,  magazines  and  leaflets  on
Buddhism  in  Sinhala,  Tamil,  English  and  other
languages  deirable  for  the  national  and  religious
development;
to  conserve  and  exhibit  the  antiquities and  the
monuments of heroes ;
to establish and maintain social welfare centres for
Buddhist who are destitute and old  ;
to  establish  institutions  to  provide  training  on
computer and mass media to the Buddhist Priests,
Damma School Teachers’ and students ;
